messages:
deploybot: Scheduled maintenance window: 2026-04-10 01:00-03:00 UTC for runtime security patch in eu-west-1. Affected: hosted inference endpoints in that region. Autoscaling: enabled. :robot_face:

katie - support: Noted. Can we draft the statuspage blurb now so CS has it ready for customers?

sanjay - eng-oncall: +1. We plan a rolling host drain per AZ, no full region outage expected. Rollout plan attached in the runbook. If p99 latency > 800ms for more than 5m we'll pause and triage.

jo - eng-releases: Quick note: we'll pin the model variants to v2.4.1 during the window to avoid unexpected kernel switches. Post-maint we can unpin once quantized kernels are validated.

lee - eng-platform: Working on canary in eu-west-1a first. If canary OK after 15m we'll continue. Fallback route: route requests to eu-central until EU catchup completed.

maria - product: Customer-facing draft: "We will be performing a maintenance update to improve runtime security and performance in eu-west-1. During the window, some requests may see brief latency spikes; we do not expect sustained downtime. If your app requires absolute zero impact please reach out to support to discuss Dedicated/Private options." Thoughts?

katie - support: Nice. Suggest adding "we will post live updates on status.redwood.ai" and a contact link. Also include scheduled start and end in the message.

statuspage-bot: New incident created: RWI-2026-04010-eu-runtime-maintenance. Status: Scheduled. Incident page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/RWI-2026-04010-eu-runtime-maintenance

jo - eng-releases: Proposed statuspage snippet (for copy/paste):
```
Scheduled maintenance: 2026-04-10 01:00-03:00 UTC (eu-west-1)
Summary: Applying a security and stability patch to our inference runtime.
Impact: Brief latency increases for hosted API in eu-west-1; no expected sustained downtime.
Mitigation: Rolling AZ updates, canary validation, cross-region fallback to eu-central.
Updates: We'll post progress and any customer-impacting events on this incident page.
```

lee - eng-platform: Ops checklist before publish:
- confirm on-call engineer for the window (sanjay)
- preflight smoke in canary cluster at -24h and -2h (lee)
- run dry-run of host drain script in test env (jo)
- pre-publish pinned model config (v2.4.1) (jo)
- notify top 10 customers via CS with ETA and a support alias (katie)

sanjay - eng-oncall: I will be primary on-call for the window. Escalation: lee -> eng-sre -> eng-vp. If rollback triggered, mark incident as "rollback in progress" and move customer comms to "Investigating/Degraded".

katie - support: Customer comm template for top customers (short):
"Hi <Customer>,
We will perform a scheduled maintenance in eu-west-1 on 2026-04-10 01:00-03:00 UTC to apply a security patch to the runtime. You may observe brief latency spikes. We do not expect sustained downtime. If you rely on pinned Dedicated capacity, this maintenance will not affect Dedicated clusters. We'll post live updates here: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/RWI-2026-04010-eu-runtime-maintenance
Regards, Redwood Support"

maria - product: Add a note about model pinning fallback so customers know their pinned versions remain stable: "If you have pinned model versions, we will preserve pins during this maintenance."

jo - eng-releases: Rollback criteria (ops decision):
- Error rate (5xx) > 2% sustained for 10m OR
- p50 latency regression > 300ms sustained for 20m OR
- Any customer-facing data corruption reports
If any condition hit -> initiate rollback, post to incident, run failover to eu-central, and start postmortem.

sanjay - eng-oncall: Agreed. I'll update the runbook with those exact thresholds and add a rapid-rollback play.

lee - eng-platform: One more: we need a minimal release note snippet to include in weekly release email: "Applied runtime security patch and infra optimizations in eu-west-1; no customer action required."

katie - support: I'll queue the statuspage update and the top-10 customer emails once jo confirms the pinned config is uploaded. Can someone confirm when that is done?

jo - eng-releases: I will upload pinned config today by 18:00 UTC and post the confirmation here.

deploybot: Deployment runbook link: https://internal.redwood.ai/runbooks/eu-runtime-maint-2026-04-10 | Run ID: run_6442

sanjay - eng-oncall: Preflight smoke passed in canary at -24h. 

jo - eng-releases: Pinned config uploaded at 1769471420. Confirmed.

katie - support: Statuspage draft published as Scheduled. Top-10 emails scheduled to send 90m before window.

lee - eng-platform: Marking thread for follow-ups during the window. Good work team. :thumbsup:
